findings.evidence: Functoriality.lean:82-87; contrast PointsAction.lean:53 `-- \`pointsAction\` has no equation lemma to rewrite with; \`change\` spells out its definitional unfolding once, explicitly.`
findings.fix: Either add a comment stating why the goal is unreachable by rewriting, or drop the `change`: prove `heq` by `Units.ext`/`LinearMap.ext` and rewrite with `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.congrLinearEquiv_apply`, `toLinearEquiv_inv`, `LinearEquiv.coe_inv`.
findings.issue: The new `isSemisimple_conj_iff` uses `change` with no comment justifying it; it restates `(h * g * h⁻¹) v` as a nested application of `toLinearEquiv`, i.e. relies on unstated defeq across the `Units`/`LinearEquiv` wrappers. Every other `change` in this repo is documented (JordanDecomposition.lean:124, Multiplicative.lean:177, PointsAction.lean:53).

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Units/Hom.lean:83 `theorem coe_map_inv (f : M →* N) (u : Mˣ) : ↑(map f u)⁻¹ = f ↑u⁻¹`.
findings.fix: Use `rw [← hunit, Units.coe_map_inv]` (or `simp [Units.coe_map_inv]`) instead of the bare `rfl`.
findings.issue: `hinv` is closed by `rw [← hunit]; rfl`, i.e. by undocumented definitional equality between `↑(Units.map B.subtype hx.unit)⁻¹` and `((hx.unit⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B : A)`. An explicit Mathlib lemma covers exactly this step.

findings.fix: Add `GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_one` next to `ofLinearEquiv_pow` in Adjoin.lean (`map_one (generalLinearEquiv K V).symm`) and rewrite with it before `exact`.
findings.issue: `isSemisimplePoint_one` does `rw [map_one]` leaving the goal on `ofLinearEquiv (1 : _ ≃ₗ[K] _)` and then closes it with `exact GeneralLinearGroup.isSemisimple_one`, unifying `ofLinearEquiv 1` with `1` by defeq. Mathlib has `ofLinearEquiv_mul`/`ofLinearEquiv_inv` but no `ofLinearEquiv_one`, and the PR itself adds `ofLinearEquiv_pow` for precisely this reason — so the `one` case is the only unstated one.

findings.evidence: SemisimplePoint.lean:190-204 duplicates PointFaithful.lean:58-70 and PointFaithful.lean:100-106 (`rw [cancel_epi] at happ` / `rw [cancel_mono] at happ` / `congrArg SemimoduleCat.Hom.hom happ`).
findings.fix: Factor the block into one reusable lemma (e.g. in JordanDecomposition.lean or ScalarExtension.lean) of the form `eqToHom h ≫ e₁.toModuleIsoₛ.hom ≫ eqToHom h.symm = eqToHom h ≫ e₂.toModuleIsoₛ.hom ≫ eqToHom h.symm ↔ e₁ = e₂`, and use it here and at the two existing copies.
findings.issue: The reverse direction re-derives, for a third time, the boilerplate that turns equality of two `Aut (scalarExtensionFunctor …)` into equality of the underlying linear maps: `congrArg (·.hom.app M)` → `rw [cancel_epi]` → `rw [cancel_mono]` → `congrArg SemimoduleCat.Hom.hom` → `simpa only [LinearEquiv.toModuleIsoₛ_hom, SemimoduleCat.hom_ofHom, …]`. This eqToHom-cancellation chain is unexplained and brittle to any change in the component shape.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and lemma-driven, but the PR adds one undocumented `change`, two places that close goals by unspoken coercion defeq where an explicit lemma exists or should be added, and a third copy of the cancel_epi/cancel_mono component-extraction boilerplate.
